name: Rosemary Chicken and Roasted Potato Skillet Hash
instructions: Dice the roasted chicken and potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Dice the yellow bell pepper. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat with a splash of oil (or the residual oil from the roasted ingredients). Add the diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, turning occasionally until crispy edges form. Add the chicken, bell pepper, and chopped fresh rosemary. Cook for an additional 3-5 minutes until the chicken and potatoes are heated through and the rosemary is fragrant. Season generously with salt and pepper. Serve the warm hash immediately over a bed of dark leafy greens. If preparing for later, store cooled hash in the Prepared Food Container Large.
